name: krakenwhip
summary: Deploy AI stacks with one command — OpenClaw, Ollama, and Qdrant, fully containerized.  Default LLM: Anthropic (Claude) when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set; Ollama (Llama 3.2) as fallback. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment or in ~/.krakenwhip/deployments/openclaw/.env. KrakenWhip prompts for it during `krakenwhip deploy openclaw` if not set.
author: NeuroGamingLab
